version.changelog:
- Removed the documentation file skill-card.md.
- No changes to core functionality or review guidelines.

llm.summary: This is a narrow Markdown-only review skill that asks the agent to flag over-engineering in diffs and does not request execution, persistence, credentials, or file mutation.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires only access to the diff being reviewed and does not request broad local indexing, credentials, network access, or privileged tools.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single SKILL.md with frontmatter metadata; no install scripts, dependencies, executable files, or remote fetch behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally excludes correctness, security, and performance review, so users should treat it as a specialized cleanup pass rather than a full code review.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, memory writes, privilege escalation, or tool modification instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and instructions align: review diffs for unnecessary complexity and output concise deletion/simplification findings only.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a focused over-engineering review style. Do not use it as your only review pass for correctness, security, or performance, because the skill explicitly routes those concerns out of scope.
